company_name: Tokyo City University, Research Center for Nanoelectronics
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company is focused on developing advanced materials and techniques for semiconductor applications, particularly in germanium-based technologies.
summary: Tokyo City University's Research Center for Nanoelectronics is pioneering the development of germanium materials for next-generation CMOS channels and optoelectronic devices. Their research includes high-quality crystal growth techniques and the fabrication of strained Si/Ge heterostructures aimed at enhancing device performance.
capabilities: High-quality crystal growth of strained Si/Ge heterofilms
Development of ultra-low-power optoelectronic spin-fusion devices
Molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) for semiconductor heterostructures

regional_presence.Japan: The research center is located in Japan, focusing on advanced semiconductor materials and technologies.
